## About

SeisReconNO provides reproducible material for *SeisReconNO: Leveraging a U-Net-Enhanced Fourier Neural Operator for 3D Seismic Reconstruction* [@traversa2026seisreconno]. The project addresses missing traces in 3D seismic data using a mesh-invariant reconstruction approach that combines spectral and spatial representations.

::: {.callout-note}
This page is based on the public project record. Expand it only with approved figures, contributors, benchmarks, and research context.
:::

## Why it matters

Missing seismic traces degrade downstream imaging and interpretation. A research project page should explain that practical problem before directing technical readers to the implementation and paper.
